title: Multiple Server List Files
description: A mod to allow you to have view and edit multiple server list files in the Multiplayer menu.
body: A mod to allow you to have view and edit multiple server list files in the Multiplayer menu. When loading the server list, the default file (servers.dat) will be used from the servers folder. You can edit the text in the text box to choose a new server list to view/edit, hover over a serverr, or use the scroll wheel on the text box it to switch betwen existing server list files.
